M91 class-C fixture, performed by the human on #1914, not by #1925.

From the repository, source tools/env-check.sh. Create a fresh isolated share:
  mkdir -p artifacts/m91-workflow
  fixture=$(mktemp -d "$PWD/artifacts/m91-workflow/human.XXXXXX")
  mkdir -p "$fixture/share/EDIT"
  cp tests/fixtures/desktop/m91/editor.txt "$fixture/share/EDIT/SEED.TXT"
  VIRELAI_SESSION_SHARE="$fixture/share" bash tools/session.sh
Do not override wm, seed GOTABWM.DEMO, or skip builds. Use no personal share.

Activate the VM window. With the initial GOSH tab open, click Apps. Observe
readable names and available/unavailable states. Click Terminal, without a
keyboard launcher shortcut. In the guest Terminal, type:
  echo m91-desktop-workflow-ok > /host/M91-1925.RECEIPT
  cat /host/M91-1925.RECEIPT
Open Apps and click Code Editor. At the empty line after "M91 editor seed",
type "worked" and Enter, then save with Ctrl-S.
Switch tabs normally. With the editor focused, open Apps, filter, Escape,
then open and dismiss outside. Its text must remain unchanged. Click header
and padding: neither launches. One normal click must never launch twice or
select/drag content under the menu. A missing fixture-owned binary must show
an honest unavailable state; never remove an operator-owned binary.

Save guest scanouts and the session serial log inside the fixture. Stop only
this VM, then independently compare on the host:
  cmp tests/fixtures/desktop/m91/receipt.expected "$fixture/share/M91-1925.RECEIPT"
  cmp tests/fixtures/desktop/m91/editor.expected "$fixture/share/EDIT/SEED.TXT"
  cp artifacts/session-serial.log "$fixture/boot-1.log"
Relaunch using the SAME VIRELAI_SESSION_SHARE, without build-skip flags. Read
the receipt through a real Terminal opened from Apps, stop, and run both
host cmp commands again. Restored tabs are placeholders, not running apps.
Record real native input, activation, close/relaunch and pixels on #1914.
Injected gates
and successful byte comparisons alone are not human desktop acceptance.
